hooks.command: [ -n "$TMUX" ] && CWD=$(jq -r '.cwd // ""' | xargs basename 2>/dev/null) && [ -n "$CWD" ] && { N=$(tmux list-windows -F '#W' | grep -E "^cc/${CWD}[0-9]+$" | sed -E "s|^cc/${CWD}||" | sort -n | tail -1); tmux rename-window "cc/${CWD}$((${N:-0} + 1))"; }
W=$(tmux display-message -p '#W' 2>/dev/null | sed 's|^cc/||'); osascript -e "display notification \"${W:-done}\" with title \"Claude · done\" sound name \"Tink\""
W=$(tmux display-message -p '#W' 2>/dev/null | sed 's|^cc/||'); osascript -e "display notification \"${W:-input}\" with title \"Claude · needs you\" sound name \"Glass\""
